_notes: Free-quote page (/free-quote/), blueprint C5. One page, six inputs. The website stores nothing: Send opens the visitor's own email app with the request written out (mailto), and an in-page panel offers Copy request, the address, Call/Text (only once PHONE is known) and Gmail/Outlook web links. Keys: seo, h1, lede; reassurance (array of short strings shown as a strip under the H1); fields (the six inputs, in order; field 'name' values are stable and are read by site/src/scripts/quote.js: services, area, description, timing, name, contact, plus the conditional phone input nested in contact.phone); each field has label, optional help, optional placeholder/examples, and errors {required, ...}; options [{value, label, subject?, hint?}] where 'subject' is the short label used in the email subject. errorSummary {heading, intro}; buttons {submit, copy, copied, copyAddress, copiedAddress, reopen, edit, gmail, outlook, call, text}; messages {submitHelp, noJs, privacy, ready {heading, body, noEmail}, truncated, copyFailed, smsBody}; nextSteps {heading, items[{title, body}]} ('What happens next'); credentials {heading, lede} (the row itself is ui.credentialRow tokens); aside {image, heading} (photo slot and heading for the side column); sections[] (other ways to reach us). Retired: the 4-step 'steps' key (replaced by 'fields' with the redesign; nothing else read it). {count} in errorSummary.intro is replaced with the number of problems. [REPLY TIME], [EMAIL], [PHONE] and credential tokens stay as tokens until RNC confirms them.

seo.title: Free landscaping quote in Greater Victoria | RNC
seo.description: Ask RNC Landscaping for a free, no-obligation quote in Greater Victoria. Six quick questions, then your own email app sends it. Every quote is site-specific.

lede: Six quick questions. Then your own email app opens with the request written out, so you can add photos and send it yourself. Nothing is stored on this website.
reassurance: No prices shown here: every quote is site-specific

fields.name: services
fields.label: What do you need help with?
fields.help: Choose all that apply. Not sure? Pick the closest and tell us more below.

errors.required: Choose the municipality where the property is.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Tell us about the property and the job
fields.help: A few sentences is plenty. You can attach photos in your email app before you send.
examples: Strata of 24 townhouses, looking for weekly grounds care from March.
Front yard: remove the lawn, add a small patio and drought-tolerant planting.
Irrigation system needs a spring start-up and two zones aren't working.

errors.required: Tell us a little about the job so we can prepare.
errors.minLength: Add a few more words (at least 10 characters).
errors.maxLength: Keep this under 2,000 characters. You can send more detail later.

fields.name: timing
fields.label: When would you like the work done?

errors.required: Choose when you would like the work done.

fields.name: contact
fields.label: Best way to reach you
fields.help: You're sending from your own email, so we already have your address.

errors.required: Choose how we should reach you.

phone.name: phone
phone.label: Phone number
phone.labelNoJs: Phone number (needed if you choose Call me or Text me)

errors.required: Enter a phone number so we can call or text you, or choose Reply by email.
errors.format: Enter a phone number with the area code, like 250 555 0123.

errorSummary.heading: Check your request
errorSummary.intro: {count} answer(s) need a fix before your email can be written:

messages.submitHelp: Opens your email app with your request filled in. Nothing is sent until you press send there.
messages.noJs: Your email app will open with your answers as plain text. Check them, then press send.
messages.privacy: We use your details only to reply to this request. This website stores nothing; see the [privacy policy](/privacy/).

ready.heading: Your email should now be open
ready.body: Check it, attach any photos, then press send in your email app. Didn't open? Use one of these instead.
ready.noEmail: Our email address will be confirmed soon. Until then, copy your request and keep it handy, or use the [contact page](/contact/).

messages.truncated: Your request was too long to fit in an email link, so the email has a shortened version. Copy the full request below and paste it into the email before sending.
messages.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text below and copy it.
messages.webmailHelp: Convenience links: they open a new message in your webmail in a new tab, with the same subject and text.
messages.smsBody: Hi RNC, I've just sent a free quote request from your website.

items.title: We read your request
items.body: We reply within [REPLY TIME], by email, call or text, as you asked.

items.title: We look at the site
items.body: If the job needs it, we arrange a visit to measure and see the conditions.

items.title: You get a written quote
items.body: Scope and schedule in writing. No obligation, and nothing is booked until you say yes.

credentials.heading: Insurance and credentials
credentials.lede: Details we confirm in writing with every quote.

sections.heading: Prefer to talk?
body: Hours, service areas and other ways to reach us are on the [contact page](/contact/). Answers to common questions are in the [FAQ](/faq/).
